subject: Security intake: CAIQ deep-dive, archival playbook, and artifact handoff
messages:
From: Diane Lee <diane.lee@aurorahealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ / SOC2 intake — request to schedule deep-dive and artifact list

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this on. Aurora's InfoSec team is running a vendor review this month and we'd like to do a CAIQ + SOC 2 intake with Redwood to cover scope, logging samples, and retention details. High-level asks from our side: (1) CAIQ walkthrough and mapping to Redwood controls; (2) example audit/log samples for a 30-day window; (3) confirmation of retention and deletion playbook; (4) proof of SOC 2 coverage (if available).

Can we schedule a 45-minute call this week (Wed/Thu afternoon PST)? If helpful, I can share our intake spreadsheet ahead of time.

Attach: intake-questions-aurora.xlsx (attachment stub)

Appreciate it —
Diane Lee
Security Lead, Aurora Health
D: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Diane Lee <diane.lee@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SOC2 intake — request to schedule deep-dive and artifact list

Diane —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can run the CAIQ walkthrough and surface SOC 2 artifacts. Aditya (security/reliability lead) will join to cover logging/retention and the audit sample. Proposed slots: Wednesday 1/13 2:30–3:15pm PST or Thursday 1/14 10:00–10:45am PST. Which works best?

I'll upload our CAIQ mapping and an SOC 2 summary ahead of the call and we can triage the intake spreadsheet live.

Quick note on artifacts: we can provide an export of anonymized audit logs (sample), our retention policy doc, and a redwood-soc2-policy-summary PDF. If Aurora needs raw logs with IPs, we'll need a short MOU — can discuss.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
Attach: (none)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Aurora CAIQ intake — owners and prep

Grace / Marissa —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick ownership plan:
- Aditya: logging sample export, retention/deletion playbook, and technical Qs on KV-cache/replication.
- Marissa: evidence packaging (SOC 2 summary, CAIQ mapping), Drive folder, and post-call artifact handoff.

Prep items before the call (Wednesday slot preferred):
- Marissa: create "Aurora - CAIQ intake" Drive folder and populate with our CAIQ mapping and the redwood-soc2-policy-summary.pdf (BY EOD today).
- Aditya: generate a sanitized 7-day log sample and a short README describing fields + sampling strategy (no IPs unless Aurora signs MOU).
- Grace: send calendar invite and Aurora's intake spreadsheet to the invite.

If we need legal on the MOU we'll loop in legal; otherwise we can handle the sample with anonymization.

-Aditya
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Diane Lee <diane.lee@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ / SOC2 intake — scheduling + pre-call artifacts

Diane —

Thanks — confirmed for Wed 1/13 2:30–3:15pm PST (calendar invite sent). Agenda and pre-work below:

Agenda (45 min):
- 5m: Introductions and scope confirmation
- 20m: CAIQ walkthrough (control highlights + our mapping) — Marissa
- 10m: Logging samples, retention, and deletion playbook — Aditya
- 5m: Next steps and artifact handoff cadence
- 5m: Q&A / follow-ups

Pre-call artifacts attached/shared:
- redwood-caiq-mapping.xlsx (Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AEXAMPLE123/CAIQ-artifacts)
- redwood-soc2-policy-summary.pdf (attached)
- sample-audit-logs.tar.gz (will be uploaded to the Drive folder after anonymization)

Action items before meeting:
- Aurora: if possible, flag any CAIQ sections you want prioritized in the walkthrough (control IDs).
- Redwood: Marissa will upload the CAIQ mapping now; Aditya will post the sanitized log sample to the Drive by EOB today.

If Aurora prefers a recorded session + transcript, we can record and share.

Thanks and looking forward —
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-policy-summary.pdf (attachment stub), redwood-caiq-mapping.xlsx (Drive link)
